# Security policy

## Supported versions

The latest published release is the supported version. Security fixes are developed against the current default branch and included in a subsequent release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/apimgr/anime/security/advisories/new), the primary reporting channel. Do not file vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions, or pull requests. On repository mirrors without private reporting, report the issue to the GitHub origin first.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, and steps to reproduce. Avoid sending real user data or credentials. Maintainers will acknowledge reports and coordinate a fix and disclosure with the reporter.

On a running deployment, `/server/security` describes the available reporting channel and `/.well-known/security.txt` provides machine-readable contact information. The report form is not enabled by this project configuration.
